lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Five primary vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the fifth gill slit, with decreasing spot density observed towards the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Clearly defined vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with high-luminance circular spots to form a repeating grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges running across the upper flank, characterized by a high-contrast transition from high-luminance (dorsal) to shadow (ventral) along the ridge crests.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately 12 visible high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily along the leading edge of the first dorsal fin's partial silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant V-shaped notch on the posterior margin of the left pectoral fin; several small dark punctate marks located on the head region anterior to the gill slits.
